dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Muning's brought some people to help search for her, and they found some secret passages that lead into unknown terrain...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: But it's too dangerous to keep on searching. I've no clue where that kid's gone, really.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: To be honest, I don't know if I should give her a good hiding or make her soup when she returns...
